subject: science
prompt_en: Predict: you fill an ice tray right to the top with water and freeze it. Will the ice be level with the top, below it, or bulging above it?
prompt_hi: Guess karo: ice tray ko bilkul upar tak paani se bhar ke jamao. Barf upar ke kinare ke barabar hogi, neeche hogi, ya upar ubhri hogi?
answer: It bulges slightly above the top, because water expands when it freezes.

subject: science
prompt_en: Why does an ice cube float in a glass of water?
prompt_hi: Ice cube paani ke glass mein tairta kyon hai?
answer: Water expands when it freezes, so ice is lighter than the same volume of water, and it floats.

subject: science
prompt_en: Watching from a safe distance, compare the clear gap right at a kettle's spout with the white cloud a little above it. Which is water vapour, and what is the white cloud?
prompt_hi: Door se, safely dekhte hue, ketli ki tonti ke theek paas ki saaf jagah aur thoda upar ka safed baadal compare karo. Bhaap (water vapour) kaunsi hai, aur safed baadal kya hai?
answer: The clear gap is invisible water vapour; the white cloud is tiny water droplets formed as the vapour cools in the air and condenses.

subject: science
prompt_en: Kulfi left on the table becomes liquid. You put it back in the freezer and it becomes solid again. Name both changes.
prompt_hi: Mez pe chhodi kulfi paani-paani ho jaati hai. Use wapas freezer mein rakho toh phir se jam jaati hai. Dono badlaavon ke naam batao.
answer: Melting, then freezing.

subject: science
prompt_en: In Ladakh in winter, lakes freeze on top but fish survive below. How is this possible?
prompt_hi: Ladakh mein sardi mein jheelon ki upar ki sateh jam jaati hai, par machhliyan neeche zinda rehti hain. Ye kaise mumkin hai?
answer: Ice is lighter, so it forms and floats on top; this layer of ice works like a lid that keeps the water below from freezing, so the water underneath stays liquid and the fish live there.

subject: science
prompt_en: Draw ice, water and water vapour at the corners of a triangle. Label each arrow between them with the name of the change.
prompt_hi: Ek triangle ke 3 konon pe barf, paani aur bhaap banao. Inke beech ke har teer pe badlaav ka naam likho.
answer: Ice → water: melting; water → ice: freezing; water → vapour: evaporation or boiling; vapour → water: condensation.

subject: science
prompt_en: Golu says: 'When water boils, the bubbles are air going in, and the white steam I see is water vapour.' Find both mistakes.
prompt_hi: Golu kehta hai: 'Paani ubalne pe bulbule hawa ke hote hain jo andar jaati hai, aur jo safed bhaap dikhti hai woh water vapour hai.' Dono galtiyan dhundho.
answer: 1) The big bubbles are water vapour forming inside the water, not air. 2) The white cloud is tiny water droplets; real water vapour is invisible.

subject: science
prompt_en: Explain to a younger child the difference between melting and dissolving, using ice and sugar.
prompt_hi: Ek chhote bachche ko barf aur cheeni ke example se pighalne aur ghulne ka farak samjhao.
answer: Key ideas: melting is one substance changing from solid to liquid when warmed (ice → water, still water); dissolving is a solid spreading into a liquid to make a solution (sugar in water); two different changes.

subject: science
prompt_en: From last time: at what temperature does water boil at sea level?
prompt_hi: Pichhli baar se: samudra tal pe paani kis temperature pe ubalta hai?
answer: About 100 °C.

subject: science
prompt_en: What is condensation? Give one example.
prompt_hi: Condensation (sanghanan) kya hai? Ek example do.
answer: Water vapour cooling and changing into liquid droplets; e.g. drops outside a cold glass, mist on a mirror, dew on grass.

subject: science
prompt_en: Predict: on a humid day you take a cold water bottle out of the fridge and wipe it dry. What will you see on its outside after a few minutes?
prompt_hi: Guess karo: umas wale din fridge se thandi botal nikaal ke pochh do. Kuch minute baad bahar kya dikhega?
answer: Tiny water drops; water vapour in the air condenses on the cold surface.

subject: science
prompt_en: Predict: a spoonful of water in a steel plate is left on the table, not in the sun and not heated. After a day, what happens?
prompt_hi: Guess karo: steel ki plate mein ek chammach paani mez pe rakha hai, na dhoop mein, na garam kiya. Ek din baad kya hoga?
answer: It evaporates and the plate becomes dry, even though the water never boiled.

subject: science
prompt_en: Predict: you breathe on a cold steel plate and then on a warm one. On which will a misty patch appear more clearly?
prompt_hi: Guess karo: tum ek thandi steel plate pe aur phir ek garam plate pe phoonk maarte ho. Kis pe dhundhla nishaan zyada saaf dikhega?
answer: On the cold plate; the water vapour in your warm breath condenses on the cool surface.

subject: science
prompt_en: You said the drops outside the cold bottle are clear even when the drink is coloured. Why can't they have come through the bottle?
prompt_hi: Tumne kaha thandi botal ke bahar ki boondein saaf hoti hain chahe andar rangeen ho. Woh botal ke andar se kyon nahi aa sakti?
answer: The bottle is sealed and the drink can't pass through it; the drops come from water vapour in the surrounding air that cools on the bottle and condenses.

subject: science
prompt_en: Compare boiling and evaporation: when and where does each happen?
prompt_hi: Ubalna aur evaporation compare karo: dono kab aur kahan hote hain?
answer: Boiling happens at about 100 °C, all through the water with bubbles, and needs strong heating. Evaporation happens at any temperature, slowly, only from the surface.

subject: science
prompt_en: On winter mornings you see tiny drops on grass and on car windscreens. Where did they come from?
prompt_hi: Sardi ki subah ghaas aur gaadi ke sheeshe pe chhoti boondein dikhti hain. Ye kahan se aayin?
answer: This is dew: water vapour in the air condensed on surfaces that cooled down during the cold night.

subject: science
prompt_en: Explain how water from the Bay of Bengal can end up as rain on a farm in Odisha.
prompt_hi: Samjhao ki Bay of Bengal ka paani Odisha ke kisi khet pe baarish banke kaise pahunch sakta hai.
answer: The sun warms the sea water and it evaporates into water vapour; the vapour rises, cools and condenses into tiny droplets that form clouds; winds carry the clouds over land; the droplets join and fall as rain.

subject: science
prompt_en: Draw the water cycle with arrows: sea, sun, clouds, rain, river. Label evaporation and condensation.
prompt_hi: Teer ke saath water cycle banao: samundar, suraj, baadal, baarish, nadi. Evaporation aur condensation likho.
answer: Sea → (evaporation) vapour rises → (condensation) clouds → rain on land → rivers → back to the sea.

subject: science
prompt_en: Golu says: 'Clothes dry only on sunny days, because the sun boils the water out of them.' What is wrong?
prompt_hi: Golu kehta hai: 'Kapde sirf dhoop wale din sookhte hain, kyonki suraj unka paani ubaal deta hai.' Galti kya hai?
answer: Clothes dry on cloudy days too, just more slowly; water evaporates at any temperature without boiling, and the sun only speeds it up.

subject: science
prompt_en: Explain to a friend why a cold glass of nimbu-paani 'sweats', and how you could prove the water isn't leaking from inside.
prompt_hi: Apne dost ko samjhao ki thande nimbu-paani ka glass 'paseena' kyon chhodta hai, aur kaise saabit karoge ki paani andar se nahi nikal raha.
answer: Key ideas: water vapour in the warm air cools on the cold glass and condenses into drops; proof: add colour to the drink and see that the outside drops are clear, or use a sealed bottle that still gets drops.

subject: science
prompt_en: From last time: which process forms clouds from water vapour?
prompt_hi: Pichhli baar se: kaunsi prakriya bhaap se baadal banati hai?
answer: Condensation.

subject: science
prompt_en: Why do you feel cooler under a fan on a hot, sweaty day, even though the fan doesn't make the room's air colder?
prompt_hi: Garmi aur paseene wale din pankhe ke neeche thandak kyon lagti hai, jabki pankha kamre ki hawa ko thanda nahi karta?
answer: The moving air makes sweat evaporate faster from your skin, and evaporation takes heat away from the skin, cooling you.

subject: science
prompt_en: Predict: equal amounts of water are put in a wide plate and in a narrow glass, side by side on the same table. Which dries first?
prompt_hi: Guess karo: utna hi paani ek chaudi plate mein aur ek patle glass mein, ek hi mez pe saath rakha. Kaun pehle sookhega?
answer: The wide plate, because the water has a larger surface open to the air.

subject: science
prompt_en: Predict: a matka cools water very well in hot, dry May. Will it cool water as well in humid August during the monsoon? Why?
prompt_hi: Guess karo: garam aur sookhe Mai mein matka paani bahut achha thanda karta hai. Kya umas bhare monsoon ke August mein bhi utna hi thanda karega? Kyon?
answer: Less well; humid air slows evaporation from the pot's surface, so less heat is taken away.

subject: science
prompt_en: Predict: two identical wet handkerchiefs hang in the shade, one under a running fan and one in a still corner. Which dries first?
prompt_hi: Guess karo: chhaon mein do ek jaise geele rumaal, ek chalte pankhe ke neeche aur ek band kone mein. Kaun pehle sookhega?
answer: The one under the fan; moving air speeds up evaporation.

subject: science
prompt_en: You said the plain matka cools better than a fully painted one. Why does that show the clay isn't 'cold' by itself?
prompt_hi: Tumne kaha saada matka paint wale se behtar thanda karta hai. Isse kaise pata chalta hai ki mitti khud 'thandi' nahi hoti?
answer: The painted pot is still clay but cools less, because water can't seep out; the cooling comes from water evaporating from the outer surface, not from the clay.

subject: science
prompt_en: Compare a steel pot and a clay matka filled with the same water in the same room. Which water will be cooler after a few hours, and why?
prompt_hi: Ek hi kamre mein, ek jaise paani se bhara steel ka bartan aur mitti ka matka compare karo. Kuch ghanton baad kiska paani zyada thanda hoga, aur kyon?
answer: The matka's water; water seeps through the matka's pores and evaporates from the outside, cooling it, while the steel pot has no pores, so no water evaporates from its outer surface.

subject: science
prompt_en: When someone has a fever, why might a wet cloth strip on the forehead help them feel cooler?
prompt_hi: Bukhaar mein maathe pe geeli patti rakhne se thandak kyon mil sakti hai?
answer: Water from the cloth evaporates, and evaporation takes heat from the forehead, cooling it.

subject: science
prompt_en: People in hot, dry Rajasthan hang wet khus mats on windows or use desert coolers. Why does this cool the air coming in, and why does it work poorly in humid Kolkata?
prompt_hi: Garam aur sookhe Rajasthan mein log khidki pe geeli khus ki chatai lagaate hain ya desert cooler chalate hain. Isse andar aati hawa thandi kyon hoti hai, aur umas wale Kolkata mein ye kam kyon chalta hai?
answer: Hot, dry air passing through the wet mats makes the water evaporate, which takes heat from the air, so cooler air comes in. In humid air evaporation is slow, so there is much less cooling.

subject: science
prompt_en: Riya's results: same amount of water, same place; a wide plate dried in 2 hours and a cup dried in 6 hours. Show this as a table or bar chart and state the conclusion.
prompt_hi: Riya ke results: utna hi paani, same jagah; chaudi plate 2 ghante mein sookhi aur cup 6 ghante mein. Ise table ya bar chart mein dikhao aur nateeja likho.
answer: Plate: 2 h; cup: 6 h. Conclusion: a larger surface area makes water evaporate faster.

subject: science
prompt_en: Golu tests wind: one wet cloth hangs under a fan in the sun, the other in a shady room with no fan. The fan one dries first, so he says, 'Wind speeds up drying.' What is wrong with his test?
prompt_hi: Golu hawa ka test karta hai: ek geela kapda dhoop mein pankhe ke neeche, doosra chhaon wale kamre mein bina pankhe ke. Pankhe wala pehle sookhta hai, toh woh kehta hai, 'Hawa se jaldi sookhta hai.' Uske test mein kya galat hai?
answer: Two things changed (wind and sunlight or temperature), so he can't tell which one caused it; he should keep both cloths in the shade and change only the fan.

subject: science
prompt_en: Explain to your grandmother, in your own words, how her matka keeps water cool.
prompt_hi: Apni daadi ya naani ko apne shabdon mein samjhao ki unka matka paani thanda kaise rakhta hai.
answer: Key ideas: the clay has tiny pores; some water seeps to the outside; it evaporates from the outer surface; evaporation takes heat from the pot and the water inside, so the water cools; it works best in hot, dry, airy places.

subject: science
prompt_en: From last time: do clothes dry faster on a humid day or on a dry day?
prompt_hi: Pichhli baar se: kapde umas wale din jaldi sookhte hain ya sookhe din?
answer: On a dry day (low humidity).

subject: science
prompt_en: Which method would you use to remove small stones from a plate of dal?
prompt_hi: Dal ki thali se chhote kankar nikaalne ke liye kaunsa tareeka use karoge?
answer: Handpicking.

subject: science
prompt_en: Predict: on a windy day a farmer lets a mixture of wheat grain and husk fall from a height. Where will each land?
prompt_hi: Guess karo: hawa wale din kisaan oonchai se gehun ke daane aur bhoose ka mishran giraata hai. Dono kahan girenge?
answer: The grain is heavier and falls almost straight down near the farmer; the husk is lighter and is blown farther away.

subject: science
prompt_en: Predict: you shake a mixture of atta and some small pebbles in a kitchen sieve (chalni). What stays in the sieve and what goes through?
prompt_hi: Guess karo: aate aur kuch chhote kankaron ka mishran chalni mein hilaate ho. Kya chalni mein rahega aur kya neeche girega?
answer: The fine flour passes through; the pebbles (and any bran) stay in the sieve.

subject: science
prompt_en: Predict: can winnowing separate rice grains from small stones of the same size? Why or why not?
prompt_hi: Guess karo: kya phatakne se chawal ke daane aur unhi ke size ke chhote kankar alag ho sakte hain? Kyon ya kyon nahi?
answer: Mostly no; both are heavy and fall in about the same place. Use handpicking (by colour and shape) instead.

subject: science
prompt_en: You said the husk blows away. Why doesn't the grain blow away too?
prompt_hi: Tumne kaha bhoosa udd jaata hai. Daane bhi kyon nahi udte?
answer: The grain is much heavier, so the wind can't carry it far; the husk is light.

subject: science
prompt_en: Compare sieving and winnowing: what difference between the parts does each one use?
prompt_hi: Chhaanna (sieving) aur phatakna (winnowing) compare karo: dono hisson ke beech kaunsa farak use karte hain?
answer: Sieving uses a difference in size; winnowing uses a difference in weight (light versus heavy), with the help of wind.

subject: science
prompt_en: At a construction site, workers throw sand onto a slanted wire mesh. What are they doing, and which property are they using?
prompt_hi: Construction site pe mazdoor ret ko tirchhi jaali pe phenkte hain. Woh kya kar rahe hain, aur kaunsi property use kar rahe hain?
answer: Sieving: fine sand passes through the mesh and pebbles and stones roll off; it separates by size.
